_comment: Example route table for the gateway. This file is JSON because the
library has no third-party dependencies and must stay that way.
YAML is accepted too if PyYAML is installed: pip install 'agent-action-gateway[yaml]'.
The two settings that differ from a bare local run:
master_key_env  the variable holding the key that may issue and revoke
virtual keys. Agents never receive it.
secret_env      "file:/run/secrets/github_token" rather than a bare variable
name, because a file can have an owner and a mode. The
gateway refuses to start if that file is group- or
world-readable, or owned by anyone else.
